description: This file defines an abstract base class 'VisionService' that provides the structure and shared functionality for vision-based services in the project. It includes methods for processing image data, integrating with an AI infrastructure, and handling frame processing workflows for image analysis tasks like description, object detection, and visual question answering.

classes.name: VisionService
classes.description: Abstract base class for vision services handling image analysis and integration with AI infrastructure.
